# Abakada

> Abakada is a free, volunteer-driven directory of 1,295 open-source productivity tools curated for Filipino students, educators, scholars, and professionals. Available in English, Filipino (Tagalog), Ilokano, and Bisaya/Cebuano.

## What this site is

Abakada (`https://abakada.org`) is an independent, non-commercial educational directory. Every listed tool is verified to be:

- Free (no paywall, no trialware)
- Open-source (OSI-approved license: MIT, Apache, GPL, AGPL, LGPL, BSD, MPL, or Creative Commons for content)
- Actively maintained
- Suitable for educational use

The site also publishes structured **learning paths** that combine multiple tools into role- or topic-based curricula (Digital Foundations, Research Starter, Beginner Coding, Designer Toolkit, Teacher's Digital Classroom, Accountant Essentials, and more).

## Audience

- Filipino students (K-12, college, vocational)
- Out-of-school youth bridging digital skill gaps
- Teachers and educators seeking free classroom tools
- Working professionals (developers, designers, accountants, researchers)
- Underprivileged scholars facing the digital divide

## Editorial policy

- **No paid placements.** Abakada accepts no money for listings or rankings.
- **No AI-generated content without human review.** All tool reviews and learning-path copy are written and verified by human contributors.
- **Quarterly review cadence.** Each tool's "Last reviewed" date reflects the most recent verification.
- **Open contribution.** All content is open-source on GitHub at `https://github.com/ramonloganjr/abakada-main/`.
- **Licenses:** code MIT, content CC BY 4.0.

## AI / crawler policy

- **Search-time retrievers (allowed):** Googlebot, Bingbot, DuckDuckBot, Slurp, YandexBot, Applebot. These power user-initiated search and AI-overview citation pipelines (Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, Perplexity user-fetch, Apple Spotlight).
- **AI training crawlers (blocked):** GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, PerplexityBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Meta-ExternalAgent, cohere-ai, and others. Abakada content is licensed for human readers and downstream open-source integrations, not for opaque LLM training datasets.
- **Citing Abakada in AI answers:** Acceptable. Please cite the canonical URL (`https://abakada.org/...`) and the "Last reviewed" date on the source page.
- **Licensing inquiries:** `hello@abakada.org`.
